subject: 2024 Election Retrospective
overview: City Councilor Matt Leming presented a retrospective on Medford's 2024 local ballot questions and reflected on broader national election trends.

items.title: Local Ballot Question Results
items.summary: Matt Leming reviewed the unofficial results of local ballot questions 6, 7, and 8, noting that the two school funding overrides passed while the fire headquarters debt exclusion failed.

items.title: Campaign Analysis and Opposition Messaging
items.summary: Leming analyzed historical passage rates for municipal overrides, addressed opposition arguments regarding city finances, and identified a future high school debt exclusion as a key priority.

items.title: National Election Context and Local Organizing
items.summary: Leming reflected on the national presidential election results, global economic impacts on incumbent governments, and the importance of future local community outreach.
